Anchor stories for Friday 15 May 2026 morning brief (top 5 stories a competent UK editor would lead with today):

1. TRUMP-XI SUMMIT CLOSES — Day 2 in Beijing's leadership compound. Strategic-stability framework agreed; Xi pledged not to send military equipment to Iran; China agreed Hormuz must reopen "as soon as possible"; China agreed to buy US oil (though stopped short of confirming). Limited substantive deals beyond framing. (Geo lead)

2. JAMES MURRAY APPOINTED HEALTH SECRETARY — Starmer's overnight reshuffle: Murray (former Chief Sec to Treasury) replaces Streeting at Health; Lucy Rigby takes Murray's old Treasury post. 81-MP threshold for leadership challenge still unmet; no clear successor consensus. (UK lead)

3. IRAN ALLOWS 30+ SHIPS THROUGH HORMUZ — tacit signal of openness to commercial traffic overnight; first material easing since the war began. Vance: "fundamental question is, do we make enough progress that we satisfy the president's red line?"
   Sources: aljazeera-iran-war-day-77.txt

4. BRICS STRUGGLES FOR JOINT STATEMENT — Araghchi accuses UAE of being "directly involved in the aggression"; UAE pushback prevents consensus; India condemns attack on Indian-flagged vessel off Oman as "unacceptable"; Jaishankar acknowledges meeting "at a time of considerable flux"

5. ISRAEL-LEBANON: 2,896 KILLED SINCE MARCH; Washington talks Day 2 — ceasefire expires Sunday; Israel strikes Srifa Thursday morning (2 killed); Hezbollah drone wounds 4 Israeli civilians at Rosh Hanikra
